faqs.q: Sec. 6-6. - Sales to certain persons prohibited.
faqs.a:
It shall be unlawful for any person to sell, serve, give away, dispose of, exchange
               or deliver or permit the sale, serving, giving, or procuring of any alcoholic beverage
               to or for any person under the age of 21 years or to a visibly intoxicated person
               or to a known habitual drunkard.
(
Ord. No. 4670
, § 1, 12-17-2018)
State Law reference—
Unlawful acts, C.R.S. § 44-3-901(1).
